scope: Read-only audit of the 18 committed dist/snapshots/*.json payloads; no archive download or scientific model change
method: For each season with budbreak_date, flowering and harvest, subtract ISO dates and count distinct elapsed-day offsets
interpretation: All 235 computed calendars use identical post-budbreak elapsed-day offsets. Temperature changes budbreak timing but does not change post-budbreak flowering or harvest durations. Computed calendars include hypothetical rows and do not imply all 235 are agronomically applicable.

parameters.forcing_temperature: daily source tmean_c, starting on the UTC day chilling threshold is reached

published_bloom_curve_reconstruction.context: Citra, Florida; two bloom seasons, 2012 and 2013; mature plants; hydrogen cyanamide used; base 7 C, January 1 accumulation anchor
published_bloom_curve_reconstruction.limitations: Derived fitted-curve quantiles, not independent observed dates or general SHB classes. Published HTML prints an apparent minus-sign error in the daily temperature formula; exact accumulation implementation needs confirmation before model transfer. No live parameters changed.
